initial_image_audit.cause: Audit draft assumed json_ok is always boolean. RecordingClient intentionally stores null when json_mode is false; the three vision responses nevertheless each parse as a single JSON object. This was an audit assumption error, not a product failure.

correction: The audit derives recorded json_ok from json_mode; false-mode vision calls correctly store null. The completed image stage independently requires each of its three responses to parse as a single object. No budget, score, usage, price or input-binding expectation was relaxed. Saved image outcome equality/hash and authorized weekend rates are also checked.

visual_review.reviewers: Codex and delegated agents; not teacher/user chart or grading validation
visual_review.new_1a_readings: No material numeric/unit/legend discrepancy found; 820/220 are reasonable visual estimates and the original uncertainty note already marks estimates. Original new readings retained.
visual_review.new_1c_reading: Branch, temperatures, durations and sequence agree with independent visual review. Original new reading retained.
visual_review.old_1b_reading: Correction handled separately by main agent; not treated as a new vision request.

text_observation_contract_revision.timing: Prepared before the live evaluation stage completed; no evaluation outcomes were used to loosen expectations.
text_observation_contract_revision.product_contract: A single whole JSON object, optionally inside one complete bare/json/JSON code fence; no surrounding prose, substring extraction, or brace repair.
independent_consistency_checks: first-valid metric from the successful one-retry pipeline
text_observation_contract_revision.final_acceptance: All eight evaluations still require ready status, four valid scored criteria, matching final raw scores, correct overall, confirmed reading hash, and at most one validation retry. A truthfully recorded initial formatting failure is an observation, not an audit disagreement.
text_observation_contract_revision.synthetic_selfcheck: audit_selfcheck.py; 16/16 checks, including malformed first JSON followed by successful retry, incorrect JSON flag, invalid final JSON, separate fence observation, caps, scores, reading binding and weekend prices.
text_observation_contract_revision.historical_image_audit: image-audit.json preserves the 84/84 completed-image snapshot; it predates this text-observation revision and was not rerun against an in-progress global ledger.

completed_batch_audit.rounding_note: The product report uses Python round(value, 3): exact MAE 0.5625 is displayed as 0.562 and exact signed bias -0.1875 as -0.188. All eight score errors are exported for independent recomputation.
